subject: OrionAI pilot kickoff — scope, success metrics, and next steps
messages:
From: Aisha Patel <aisha@orionai.com>
To: connor_obrien <connor@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Miguel Torres <miguel.torres@orionai.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood pilot interest — kickoff alignment

Thanks again for the call earlier today. High-level recap from our side and a couple of asks so we can get the pilot rolling: 

Pain points we discussed:
- Generation latency is causing a poor UX in our live assistant (95th pctile > 2.2s on 1k token contexts).
- Cost per active session spikes when we scale to peak concurrency; want predictable unit economics.
- We need deterministic fallback behavior for model/quantization regressions.

Goals for the 6-week pilot:
- Reduce 95th-percentile response latency to <= 1.2s for Prompts A/B (average context 600 tokens).
- Achieve >= 30% cost reduction per 1k tokens vs current infra baseline using batching/quantized variants while maintaining output quality (see eval set).
- Implement graceful fallback to smaller model variant with zero timeouts for user-facing traffic.

Immediate asks from Aisha (OrionAI):
1) Can you share a POC charter (scope, owners, acceptance metrics, timeline) we can review today?
2) Access checklist: which AWS IAM roles, test service accounts, and sample prompt file do you need?
3) A sample prompt/eval set with expected labels so we can confirm quality baseline.

We'll loop in our infra lead (Miguel) for access and Samir (ML lead) for evals. Looking to kick off next Monday (Nov 16) if possible.

Thanks — and appreciate the clarity during the discovery call.

--
Aisha Patel
Head of Product, OrionAI
Aisha Patel | +1 415 555 0199
From: connor_obrien <connor@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha@orionai.com>, Miguel Torres <miguel.torres@orionai.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 16:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood pilot interest — kickoff alignment

Aisha — thanks for the clear recap and the goals. Attached is a first-pass POC charter that maps scope, owners, success metrics, and a proposed 6-week timeline. Key points below and next steps.

Quick summary (from our side):
- Scope: focus on "assist" flows for web and mobile (Prompt A: short Q/A; Prompt B: multi-turn summarization) with production-like load testing and a small canary in prod for fallback verification.
- Success metrics: latency (p95 <= 1.2s), cost-per-1k tokens (target: 30% reduction), quality (automatic eval with target pass rate >= 92% on your labeled set, manual spot-checks).
- Owners: Connor O'Brien (Redwood) — project lead & technical contact; Marissa Cole — CS lead for onboarding and evals; Priyom Das — infra and access checklist owner.
- Timeline (proposed): Week 0: access + quick model smoke; Weeks 1–3: performance tuning (batching, quantization); Week 4: evals & manual quality review; Week 5: canary + fallback validation; Week 6: wrap & handoff.

Access/setup checklist (high level):
- Orion to create a test AWS role with cross-account access and attach policy for S3 read (prompt sets) and CloudWatch logs (read).
- Create one service account (redwood-poc@orionai) and add public key for SSH to the test host if needed.
- Provide a link to a small representative prompt set (CSV) and a labeled eval set (we requested sample_prompt_set.csv).

Attachments included in this message:
- orionai_poc_scope_v1.pdf (POC charter, 3 pages)
- redwood_access_checklist.xlsx (compact access checklist + IAM policy snippets)
- sample_prompt_set.csv (10 sample prompts + expected outputs)

Next steps I propose by end of day:
- You confirm the pilot kickoff date (Nov 16) or suggest an alternate.
- Miguel / your infra team provision the test role and share the role ARN.
- Orion shares the labeled eval CSV and any non-production data constraints.

If that aligns, Marissa will schedule a 30-min kickoff this Friday to walk through the attachments and owners.

Connor
Director, Solutions 
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha@orionai.com>, connor_obrien <connor@redwood.ai>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 08:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood pilot interest — kickoff alignment

Adding a couple of operational acceptance items for clarity — these will be part of our gate criteria at the end of Week 4: 

Operational acceptance / evaluation plan:
- Automatic eval: run Redwood eval harness on your labeled set; pass threshold >= 92% (precision/recall metric attached in doc).
- Latency testing: load tests using client-replay with representative traffic — p95 must be <=1.2s for the two prompt families at target concurrency.
- Cost measurement: we will run a 48-hour synthetic run at representative traffic to measure tokens and billable units and compare against baseline.
- Rollout plan: canary (1%) in production traffic for 24–72 hours with auto-fallback to quantized model variant if quality drops > 3% on rolling eval.

I have scheduled the 30-min kickoff for Fri Nov 13 at 11:00 PT (calendar invite sent). Priyom — I'll need a short runbook from you describing the exact artifacts we need from Orion infra (role ARN, sample S3 path, any IP allowlist). Neha, I'm looping you for billing & quota (we may need temporary burst capacity).

See the attached charter for detailed success criteria.

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
